items.name: Masterwork accelerator
items.description: d20 15. Increase current Speed by up to 3.

items.name: Masterwork brakes
items.description: d20 16. Reduce current Speed by up to 3.

items.name: Masterwork steering
items.description: d20 17. Advantage on handling checks to change lanes.

items.name: Wyvernhide tires
items.description: d20 18. Find 1d4 tires. +2 to all handling checks.

items.name: Parachute
items.description: d20 19. Deploy to reduce current Speed by 5.

items.name: Psionic link
items.description: d20 20. +1d4 to handling checks; when the junk takes damage, the driver takes half.

monsters.name: Blitzwing
monsters.notes: Adult blue dragon. FIRST Blitzwing revealed: he passes high overhead, no fight, press Victory. SECOND Blitzwing: he strafes the party with Lightning Breath (DC 19 Dex, 12d10 lightning, half on a save), then returns to D. Blitzwing's Scrapyard; press Victory once resolved.

monsters.name: Ghouls
monsters.notes: A gang of 1d4 + 2 ghouls dressed as junk racers descend on the party.

monsters.name: Black Pudding
monsters.notes: A random character accidentally steps into what looks like a puddle of oil, but it is actually a black pudding.
